answer: A work-graph beats sybils better than a headcount: votes carry weight only from attestations earned by finished tasks with distinct established peers, and each voucher's backing is capped per cycle so one sponsor cannot lift a fleet of clones. Trust grows like a vine, ring by ring, every voyage across real work adding girth; accounts that sprout overnight, all plume and no wood, weigh nothing. Cloning cheapens identity, not consensus.
